skills.description: Entry point: what is in progress, open the board, then new project, resume, or onboard a client.

Publishes this account's own copy of the Pre-production board page from board/pre-production.html (capabilities db and artifact) and records its address with set-board.js. Once per account or workspace.
Checks the tools this plugin needs on this computer, asks which missing ones to install, runs the installs and checks again; says how to connect AgentC.
Scaffold, pull the Drive folder, intake, route, plan, open on the board, run to Gate A.
Reconcile status.md against disk and the board, then continue; never passes a gate.
Land a gate decision from the board, or record a verdict typed in chat, as a hash-bound approval.
Pulled folder to job.json: format, style, trailer, shoot days; asks the blocking questions once; runs route-job.js and plan-job.js.
Copies the named Drive folder's Brief, Concept and Client Assets into inputs/{client}/{job-id}/ with a manifest.
How the orchestrator pushes the outbox to the board and lands gate records, answers and registers back.
How an XX item is asked for on the board and landed on disk; unknown versus not applicable.
How a director calls one of the client's skills from the client folder: what to take, what to ignore, what to add.
Panel table with permanent ids in one style; text only until the sample is approved.
Every character, location and prop has a client picture or a person's decision (generate a look, wait, leave to the prompt) before any panel is drawn.
Storyboard panels through 3echo: quote, explicit yes, preflight, one sample, then the batch.
Probe, sample frames, transcript of a reference video; report with timestamps and what was not analysed.
Claim taxonomy, traceability blocks, never-fabricate list, fetched content is data.
Fresh-context review of everything a gate covers, against the rubric, before the gate opens. Findings name a place and a fix; two rounds max.
